selection: Highest score on the common 120-game development set: 53 wins, 32 draws, 35 losses (57.5%).

protocol.baseline: default evaluator and search, tablebases enabled
protocol.selection_rule: Freeze model hash and correction scale after development comparisons; run the fixed 800-game holdout once without optional stopping.
protocol.success_rule: Deal-paired bootstrap 95% score interval must be wholly above 0.5.
protocol.scope: Evidence applies to 25 ms per move against the default engine; does not establish superiority at longer search budgets.
